jobs.title: Web Developer

jobs.title: Web & Backend Security Analyst
jobs.summary: Test web applications, APIs and backends for vulnerabilities and help the team fix them before they are exploited.
jobs.description_md:
We are looking for a security analyst to assess the websites, web applications and backend systems we build and run. You will find weaknesses, explain the risk and help the developers fix them.

This role works under clear rules of engagement and a strict code of ethical practice. You will only test systems you are authorised to test.
jobs.responsibilities_md:
- Assess web applications and APIs for common vulnerabilities.
- Review backend configuration, authentication and access control.
- Run vulnerability scans and verify the findings manually.
- Write clear reports with risk ratings and practical fixes.
- Advise developers on secure coding and re-test after fixes.
jobs.requirements_md:
- Good understanding of the OWASP Top 10 and web application security.
- Hands-on experience with tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP or similar.
- Knowledge of how APIs, authentication and sessions work.
- Examples of past assessments, write-ups, labs or reported issues.
- A strong ethical approach and willingness to work under NDA and rules of engagement.
jobs.nice_to_have_md:
- Experience with cloud or server hardening.
- Scripting skills in Python or Bash.
